limitations: One simulated mobile run per page; these are laboratory observations, not real-user Core Web Vitals.
INP and CrUX field data were not measured.
Localhost excludes production network, CDN, serverless cold starts and TLS behavior.
Analytics is intentionally disabled on localhost; these measurements do not include the live GA request cost.
Lighthouse SEO and accessibility scores do not establish ranking position or complete accessibility compliance.
No live forms, credentials or real candidate information were submitted.
The initial jobs run scored performance 100 with TBT 0 ms; the final run scored 98 with TBT 150 ms. Single-run variability is retained rather than selecting the highest result.
